name: FliH ATPase regulator
description: Negative regulator and docking partner of FliI.

name: FliE rod-MS ring junction
description: Joins the rod to the MS ring.

name: FliD filament cap
description: Hook-associated protein 2; the distal capping plate.

name: MotA-family stator A subunit
description: Ion-conducting stator subunit. The accession does not distinguish proton-driven MotA from sodium-driven PomA.

name: MotB-family stator B subunit
description: Peptidoglycan-binding stator subunit. The accession does not distinguish MotB from PomB.

name: LptB ATPase
description: Cytoplasmic ATPase that powers lipopolysaccharide extraction.

name: LptC connector
description: Inner-membrane complex component that connects LptBFG to the periplasmic bridge.

name: LptF permease
description: One of the two jointly required transmembrane components of the extractor.

name: LptG permease
description: One of the two jointly required transmembrane components of the extractor.

name: LptA bridge protein
description: Dedicated soluble periplasmic component of the trans-envelope bridge.

name: LptD translocon beta-barrel
description: Outer-membrane beta-barrel component of the translocon.

name: LptE translocon lipoprotein
description: Lipoprotein partner within the canonical LptD/E translocon.

name: UDP-GlcNAc 2-epimerase
description: Non-hydrolysing epimerase that produces UDP-ManNAc; the activity may be supplied by MnaA/WecB-class proteins.

name: TagO-class linkage initiator
description: Transfers GlcNAc-1-phosphate to the polyprenyl-phosphate carrier. The accepted orthology is shared with WecA/Rfe and is specific to the activity, not to WTA by itself.

name: TagA mannosaminyltransferase
description: Adds N-acetylmannosamine to the lipid-linked GlcNAc linkage precursor.

name: TagB glycerol-phosphate primase
description: Adds the conserved glycerol-phosphate unit to the WTA linkage precursor.

name: TarI ribitol-phosphate cytidylyltransferase
description: Forms CDP-ribitol from ribitol 5-phosphate and CTP.

name: Staphylococcus TarF transferase
description: Staphylococcus aureus-type glycerol-phosphate adaptor transferase, accepted only through the equivalog-grade profile.

name: Staphylococcus TarL polymerase
description: Staphylococcus-type bifunctional ribitol-phosphate primase and polymerase, accepted only through the genus-resolved equivalog profile.

name: W23-type TarK primase
description: Ribitol-phosphate primase that distinguishes the W23-type architecture.

name: W23-type TarL polymerase
description: Ribitol-phosphate polymerase required alongside TarK in the W23-type architecture.

name: TagG exporter permease
description: Membrane permease component of the WTA ABC exporter.

name: TagH exporter ATPase
description: ATP-binding component of the WTA ABC exporter.

name: LCP-family WTA attachment ligase
description: Transfers polyprenyl-linked teichoic acid to peptidoglycan; the accepted orthology covers the substitutable TagT/TagU/TagV family.

name: YpfP/UgtP-family diglucosyldiacylglycerol synthase
description: Processive glycosyltransferase that makes the glycolipid anchor named by the GIFT.

name: LtaA glycolipid flippase
description: LTA-biosynthesis MFS flippase for the diglucosyldiacylglycerol anchor.

name: LtaS poly(glycerol-phosphate) synthase
description: Polymerase that transfers glycerol-phosphate units from phosphatidylglycerol to the extracellular LTA chain.

name: TssL
description: Inner-membrane anchor of the membrane complex.

name: TssM
description: Envelope-spanning core of the membrane complex.

name: TssE
description: Baseplate wedge protein related to phage gp25.

name: TssK
description: Connects the baseplate to the membrane complex.

name: SctD
description: Outer of the two inner-membrane rings.

name: Hrp pilin
description: Major subunit of the Hrp pilus.

name: FlaG stator protein (ArlG)
description: Membrane-anchored stator protein; a paralogue of FlaF.

name: FlaH KaiC-like regulator (ArlH)
description: Regulates FlaI and is essential for assembly.

name: GspD secretin
description: Outer-membrane channel through which folded substrate passes.

name: GspC
description: Links the inner-membrane platform to the secretin.

name: GspL
description: Binds the ATPase to the platform.

name: GspG major pseudopilin
description: The subunit polymerised into the pseudopilus.

name: class III prepilin peptidase
description: Cleaves and N-methylates pseudopilin leaders. Shared with the type IVa pilus.
